View Wine List → Selected: HALIFAX'S BEST FRENCH RESTAURANT Our Story A quaint, cozy, full-of-life restaurant bringing old-world French charm right to the heart of Halifax, loved by locals since 2011. MEET OUR OWNER Liz Liz recreated Le Bistro in the exact same location she managed throughout the 90s. Haligonians were sad to see Le Bistro Café close in early 2002, when new owners changed many of its best-loved features. So Liz brought it back, her way. When she reopened in December 2011, many longtime regulars returned within days. Some had been waiting years. That's what Le Bistro has always been: a place people return to not just for the food, but for the feeling. Locals have been flocking to Le Bistro by Liz ever since. From the first cup of coffee to the last glass of wine, there's always something worth staying for. THE SPACE Charming French Bistro Décor The French-inspired décor is inviting and full of character: bistro tables topped with red and white checkered tablecloths, warm lighting, and a glassed-in atrium overflowing with greenery. From the moment you walk through the door, you're caught up in it: the unpretentious atmosphere, the buzz of friendly conversation, and the kind of genuine hospitality that's harder to find than it should be. THE KITCHEN Open Kitchen, Open Heart Our open-style kitchen means you can watch the magic happen. Chef Rabih Melhem brings classic French-inspired favourites alongside fresh, seasonal dishes. Comfort food with a French flair, made from scratch every day. From quick lunches to catch-up brunches and evenings you won't want to end, Le Bistro is the perfect spot for every occasion and every craving. Explore Our Menus
